coinGeckoAPI.section: CoinGecko API Integration: Endpoints and Data
coinGeckoAPI.description: The CoinGecko API is integrated into BlockMonitor to provide real-time cryptocurrency data. Below is an explanation of the key API endpoints used in the integration and the data they provide.

apiEndpoints.title: Get Cryptocurrency Prices (Single Coin)
apiEndpoints.description: Fetches the current price of a specific cryptocurrency (or multiple cryptocurrencies) in real-time.
apiEndpoints.example: Retrieves the prices of Bitcoin and Ethereum in USD.

apiEndpoints.title: Get Cryptocurrency Market Data
apiEndpoints.description: Provides market data for a list of cryptocurrencies, including price, market cap, volume, and more.
apiEndpoints.example: Retrieves the market data for Bitcoin and Ethereum in USD, including price, market cap, and volume.

apiEndpoints.title: Get Coin Information (Details about a Specific Coin)
apiEndpoints.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific cryptocurrency, including its full name, description, market data, and historical data.
apiEndpoints.example: Retrieves detailed information about Bitcoin, such as its description, market cap, supply, and more.

apiEndpoints.title: Get Cryptocurrency History (Price Chart Data)
apiEndpoints.description: Provides historical market data (price, market cap, volume) for a specific cryptocurrency over a given period.
apiEndpoints.example: Retrieves the Bitcoin price chart data for the last 30 days in USD.

apiEndpoints.title: Get Global Market Data
apiEndpoints.description: Provides global cryptocurrency market data, including total market cap, 24-hour trading volume, and the number of coins tracked.
apiEndpoints.example: Retrieves global market data like total market capitalization and total 24-hour trading volume for all cryptocurrencies.

apiEndpoints.title: Get Market Data from Exchanges
apiEndpoints.description: Provides information about cryptocurrency exchanges, including the top exchanges and the market pairs they offer.
apiEndpoints.example: Retrieves a list of all exchanges and their market pairs.

apiEndpoints.title: Get Trending Cryptocurrencies
apiEndpoints.description: Retrieves a list of the most trending cryptocurrencies based on user searches and activities.
apiEndpoints.example: Retrieves the currently trending cryptocurrencies, helping users discover which coins are gaining the most attention.

integrationHowItWorks.description: Whenever users check a coin’s price, BlockMonitor makes an API request to the /simple/price or /coins/markets endpoints to fetch the latest price data.
The /coins/markets endpoint provides real-time market data, which is displayed in the app to show details like market cap, volume, and supply.
For users who want to track price trends, BlockMonitor sends requests to the /coins/{id}/market_chart endpoint to retrieve historical price data for analysis.
The /coins/{id} endpoint provides users with detailed information about specific cryptocurrencies, including their market data and metadata.
By utilizing the /global endpoint, BlockMonitor can display global market data, such as the total market capitalization of all cryptocurrencies, to provide a broader view of the market.
BlockMonitor can also utilize the /search/trending endpoint to display trending cryptocurrencies, keeping users updated on popular and emerging coins.
